verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a chat platform with an API, so the axis applies. The pack shows only a bot framework and general API docs, with nothing on scoping, permission-limited bot keys, or least-privilege tokens. Running a bot is an adjacent capability, not evidence of scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
